description: This Java source file defines an abstract assertion class for Event objects, providing various assertion methods to verify properties of Event instances in tests.

classes.name: AbstractEventAssert
classes.description: An abstract assertion class for Event objects providing common assertion methods for testing Event properties.

methods.name: hasDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the Event has the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: hasCorrelationId
methods.description: Asserts that the Event has the specified correlation ID.

methods.name: hasId
methods.description: Asserts that the Event has the specified ID, either as a CharSequence or EntityId.

methods.name: hasEntity
methods.description: Asserts that the Event has the specified entity, with optional schema version.

methods.name: hasNoEntity
methods.description: Asserts that the Event has no entity.

methods.name: hasResourcePath
methods.description: Asserts that the Event's resource path matches the expected JsonPointer.

methods.name: hasManifest
methods.description: Asserts that the Event's manifest matches the expected value.

methods.name: hasType
methods.description: Asserts that the Event's type matches the expected value.

methods.name: hasName
methods.description: Asserts that the Event's name matches the expected value.

methods.name: hasRevision
methods.description: Asserts that the Event's revision matches the expected value.

methods.name: hasTimestamp
methods.description: Asserts that the Event's timestamp matches the expected Instant.
